purpose: reconcile once whether official Binance terms explicitly preserve RWUSD daily rewards while the same RWUSD balance serves as USD-M Futures margin, without using credentials or requesting market data

source_contract.expected_title: RWUSD Updates: Now Supported as a Margin Asset on Binance Futures

all_required: official article identity matches the expected code and title
official article states RWUSD is supported as USD-M Futures margin
official article states daily RWUSD rewards continue on the RWUSD margin balance in the USD-M Futures account
official article identifies at least one applicable collateral ratio or haircut boundary
retained public exchange information independently marks RWUSD marginAvailable true

economic_boundary.accepted_if_passed: scoped collateral-capital-efficiency overlay only when RWUSD is already independently required or held and Futures margin is already required by a separately justified after-cost strategy
not_accepted: opening or enlarging a Futures position
chasing VIP status or manufacturing volume
double-counting the same RWUSD base or VIP reward
assuming an historical collateral ratio is the exact current account ratio

decision_boundary.pass_action: record the structural overlay and its unresolved current-account haircut, eligibility, liquidation, auto-exchange, redemption, tax and operating gates without further public requests
decision_boundary.fail_action: terminalize the proposed RWUSD Futures reward-retention extension until materially changed official terms
decision_boundary.retry_trigger: material official RWUSD reward, Futures-margin eligibility, collateral-ratio, liquidation, auto-exchange or redemption-term change
